The proposal is to show users **carefully chosen examples of the autonomous car’s behavior that reveal its underlying objective or reward function**, such as demonstrations that distinguish defensive from aggressive driving (https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.03465).

The mechanism is to build an **implicit mental model of the car’s priorities and trade-offs**, such as safety versus efficiency. This is intended to help users anticipate its behavior in unfamiliar traffic conditions, rather than simply expect a familiar maneuver to recur (https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.03465).
